svg.title: Crackers in circulation over 60 days, by scenario
svg.desc: Eight small line charts of SQUAWK supply over 60 simulated days. Supply stays between about 4,000 and 10,000 crackers in every scenario except the sybil swarm, where idle balances across 800 accounts push it to about 57,000.
svg.text: Baked and not yet fed. One panel per scenario, at the launch rules. The sybil panel has its own scale.

path.title: Steady flock: 2,248 crackers on day 1, 8,324 on day 60, peak 8,549
